== Editing the family navigator ==
This shared navigator appears in the Versions infobox of each article in the Premiere [[Comlink]] family. To update membership, use the '''Edit versions''' link on a member article or edit this template's source. Each publication entry uses [[Template:Card version link]] with its canonical article title and concise visible label.

Add a verified publication here once and include <code><nowiki>{{Card versions/Comlink (Premiere)}}</nowiki></code> in its card template's <code>versions</code> field. Keep its existing images, text and identity.

Membership is every verified existing article in this Premiere family. Do not invent printings.

[[Comlink (V)]] is the Virtual Block 6 (Virtual Legacy) card (<code>1262_4</code>). There is no Virtual Modern Set 0 dest for this title. Join era blocks with <code>&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;!--</code> then <code>--&gt;&lt;div class="card-family-era"</code> so headings stay live.
